name: Data Driven Methods for Materials Designing
description: Overview of materials informatics and applications in materials; introduction to machine learning: regression models for property prediction; classification and clustering for materials discovery; advanced ML techniques: neural networks and deep learning in materials science; materials-specific databases and simulation integration: integration of data science with materials simulations; AI and automation in materials research: high-throughput computational screening; AI in experimental materials science; case studies and future trends; practical: data handling; building a regression and classification models; training NN; feature engineering; integrating ML with DFT simulations; high-throughput screening.
